chapter_title: The Apostle asks his Disciples: What is Cloud?
spiritual_reading:
Know that the disordered powers that have been held bound in a sufficient range of ultimate states will be loosed, and their operation will spread over the whole natural degree; and this loosening and ascent will be made manifest within the intermediate region where inner and outer meet.

Then an obscuring state will be lifted by the arousal of perverted love toward higher perception, and it will be brought to the presence of the divine wisdom that is shown there as the form of pure truth. The indication of this is sudden outward eruptions that attend conflicts of falsity, together with their reciprocal disturbances. By that divine wisdom whatever can be amended within that state will be purified, insofar as it can be turned toward the truth that is then disclosed. And the governing falsities that had ruled within it are loosened by those conflicts and are driven out and dispatched.

Yet protective powers are at once directed toward them to restrain them, because their quality is known: they are incapable of willing good. Wherever their influence touches, they bring spiritual death and loss. When the protective powers turn toward them and draw near, those falsities retreat under inner compulsion. They enter into whatever disposition they encounter and take it on, as evil seizes a form to hide in, fleeing the stronger good that pursues to bring it under order.

Thus the governing falsities, once expelled from those obscuring states, insinuate themselves into whatever they can find in the outer life, whether into some structure of perception, or into affections, or into human states. Wherever they take possession, they consume and devastate by the ardor of their own craving; for they are powers of self-love, offspring of perverted love, deprived of heavenly love.

But an obscuring state arising from falsified understanding is also lifted and brought upward toward the same manifestation of divine wisdom. Its indication is the rumbling and recurring outbursts that are heard in the intermediate region in many variations. And there are times when the governing falsities proper to that state are on occasion constrained within such falsified understanding; then they recoil from it and abandon it.

Even so, wherever they extend, they induce hardening and chilling in the outer life. They ruin interior truths in potency and the works that would proceed from them and the growing forms of spiritual life; they waste whatever region they reach.

Again protective powers are directed to restrain them; yet while those protective powers press after them to seize them, these falsities still pour out their devastation.

There is also an obscuring state arising from unstable persuasion, which is lifted into the intermediate region toward the same displayed form of wisdom. Its indication is a vehement impetus of persuasion that blows with bitterness.

Within such violent persuasions, the lives held there are purified by being driven out of falsity toward order. Again the governing falsities are stripped of that persuasive covering, and they descend from it, secure in their own character. Wherever they reach the general knowledges of the outer mind and the flowing truths of intelligence, they agitate them into turmoil and raise them into commotion; they overturn what carries the mind in outward uses and doctrines. They wreak devastation, and they seize and drag down what they can.

There is also an obscuring state that appears as enlightenment; it too is immediately taken away in the presence of the divine wisdom, which shows its mark. Its mark is that it presents itself as tranquil and undisturbing. The lives within it are cleansed through quiet order. Again, the governing falsities that are deprived of that seeming enlightenment come out; they attempt to dispose and appropriate what they can, but there the protective powers seize them.

Again there is an obscuring state from mixed and confused influx, which also rises toward the displayed form of wisdom. Its sign is that purification occurs within it through quiet and repose; yet the governing falsities that are stripped of that confusion and come forth from it profane and damage whatever they find in the outer life, in one way after another, until they are seized and brought into custody.

The coverings they leave behind in the various regions they have invaded—whether the works that had proceeded from perverted perception or the derivative formations of corrupted life—are gathered into the midst of their own domain and wither away. They bring severe spiritual dangers; yet those governing falsities also the protective powers send back into their midst. The light is drawn out of them, and the demons are cast down into a complete series of outermost prisons within the general knowledges that lie outside the ordered mind, which are the containing forms of falsities beyond the spiritual world.

These prisons and their descents continue until they reach the lowest natural ultimates beneath the final boundary of restraint.

Hear further: at times these protective powers are sent to restrain the governing falsities. Whenever the governing falsities are pursued, they plead and attempt to avert the restraint, for those protective powers hasten after them by command. Yet those governing falsities are freed only for a time and then take on external forms of perception and of corrupted life. They are sustained and fed by those derived formations of perverted perception and of corrupted life. Therefore protective powers set a guard over them, to keep them until the hour when those governing falsities are stripped of those borrowed forms and are brought up again. They are gathered above and poured back into their first states, into the very characters in which they originally were. The remaining light within them is taken away. And they too are cast down into the same complete series of outermost ways within the general knowledges outside the ordered mind, to the place where the former ones were cast. They enter into their midst, and whatever light is in them is removed.

See now: you have been instructed about these obscuring states—how they rise, and how the lives within them are purified. You have also been taught concerning the governing falsities within them—how they cause these rebellions and how they are caught. They are cast by protective powers into the outer prison when the command comes through the power of divine wisdom in its manifested form. She has authority over the whole intermediate domain and cleanses the life within it.

fills.fill: in the sea and in the rivers
fills.notes: The release spreads over the whole natural degree: earth (solid), sea and rivers (waters) before it is ‘revealed… in the atmosphere between’. This keeps the oldest cosmological register of the zone: earth, waters, air.
Completes the clause: ‘storms and its exchange…’ i.e., lightning storms and their reciprocal disturbance.
The ‘exchange’ belongs to the cloud’s internal agitation under the flashes; matches the spiritual sense ‘reciprocal disturbances’.

fills.fill: the place of the Virgin of Light
fills.notes: Purification is ‘by her’ and therefore directed ‘towards’ her own station, the manifest form of Wisdom in the intermediate region.
She reveals the light ‘to it’ (the cloud and the lives in it). Tight syntactic demand.
The angels ‘come beside’ the rulers; the rulers then flee ‘before them’ (the angels).
The rulers ‘assume whatever they meet upon’ and then ‘enter into’ the next host-form named by the lacuna.
Immediate context below lists ‘whether indeed a tree… or animals, or people’. The plural general heading fits: ‘enter into the trees’.

Makes the ensuing relative clause cohere: ‘into the trees that they did not find the way, will seize… whether indeed a tree to which they have found the way…’ i.e., ranging until they find an entry. Exact wording is constrained but not certain.
A connective is required after the description of the sign before ‘Again, there are times…’.
Carries the same devastation formula as elsewhere (‘burn and destroy’, ‘wreak destruction’): here in the opposite-thermal sense, chilling and barrenness, so ‘waste’ fits the correspondential effect.
Wind-rulers agitate waters: ‘make waves… and raise billows’. This matches the spiritual sense ‘raise them into commotion’.
Opposite of ‘carry’: they overturn ships, matching ‘overturn what carries the mind in outward uses and doctrines’.
Keeps the natural vessel-image aligned: destruction occurs upon the waters where ships are.
They ‘seize and bring them…’ i.e., drag down what they can, per spiritual sense.
‘Stripped of it before the Virgin’ is the fixed cosmological motif: approach to her likeness dissolves the cloud-covering.
Balances ‘She shall display its sign too…’.
The ‘sailing’ sign is observed in the intermediate region, consistent with the chapter’s repeated ‘in the atmosphere between’.
Introduces the next clause about the rulers: ‘Again, the rulers… are those that will come forth…’.
Completes the emergence: rulers stripped of the light-cloud ‘come forth from it’.
They ‘put upon’ and ‘take’—language of assuming a host-form/disposition.
Matches the repeated formula in ¶5 and ¶4: they seize any encountered form to inhabit.
The sign concerns purification: ‘the lives are purified in it in stillness…’.
Carries the twin term ‘stillness and repose’ from the spiritual sense; then turns to the rulers.
‘Every place that they will find upon it’—i.e., in the outer domain they can reach after stripping.
Corresponds to profanation and damage in the outer life: making regions ‘dead’ is the chapter’s established effect-language (¶4).
Prepares ‘one of … until …’: successive modes of harm.
Required to close the sequence before ‘until … they are seized’: the seizing is by angels throughout the chapter.
The remnants are ‘taken midst … wither away’: i.e., into the rulers’ own domain; then they wither. The connective restores flow.
Spiritual sense: ‘These prisons and their descents continue…’. Keeps impersonal cosmological description.
Needed to complete ‘below the feet of the Porter’.
Resumes the instruction: ‘Hear also again…’.
When pursued they flee; then ‘the angels rush after them’. Matches the chase motif in ¶4.
They ‘beseech’ the angels/commanded powers to release them. Fits spiritual sense ‘plead and attempt to avert the restraint’.
Oldest-layer concrete host-forms: ‘assume tree and the flesh’.
‘offspring of tree and that of flesh’.
Directly required by ‘set a … over them, that they might guard them’.
‘They shall be gathered together above’—standard collecting formula before judgment/stripping.
‘poured out again’ into first forms: return to original states before final casting-down.
Restores ‘first forms… images in which they first were’ in the natural layer’s paired terms (form and image).
‘They shall reach their midst again’ completes the repetitive cycle motif and matches the spiritual sense ‘They enter into their midst’.

assessment: Most lacunae are recoverable because the chapter is highly formulaic: each cloud-type follows the same correspondential sequence (ascent toward the Virgin, sign, purification of lives, stripping and descent of rulers, devastation in ultimates, angelic seizure, casting to outer prisons). Where the damaged spots sit inside these repeated templates, restorations are tight. A few places (notably ¶5 #3, ¶11 #4, ¶13 #1, ¶12 #7) remain only moderately or tentatively constrained because multiple synonymous connective phrases could fit without changing the spiritual structure.
